subject: integration
name: Ethereum light client
summary: Helios 0.12.0 (MIT upstream, pinned by hash) in a utility process: proves balances, code, storage, calls, blocks and receipts against sync-committee consensus; a signed transaction goes once to one execution server. Not Level 4: log queries, fee estimates and proofs are the server's word, reported unproven, and a log may be left out unseen; the sync asks one default beacon server, whose outage stops every read; a stale install starts from a checkpoint two named beacon servers agree on. Servers see the address and IP. Judged here by its publisher.
